name: shown by its creations
headline: Shown by its *creations*
visualData: The business card — your card and your links · one entry in their Hyperdex
Websites and games — published straight from tiles
The language — fourteen tongues, and its community fills what each one lacks
Communities — meetups and gathering places, in hives
say: Here is the pattern, shown through what people make with it. A business card: your links, passed on with a scan, with nothing to sign up for. Websites and games, published straight from tiles. The language itself, in fourteen tongues, with the community filling in what each one lacks. And real communities gathering in hives: meetups, meetings and the places where people belong. Each is the same simple pattern, in a different shape.
